reader_summary.overview: Aydin Senkut is the Founder and Managing Partner of Felicis Ventures. Its success has placed Aydin on the Forbes Midas List for the past 8 years. Our conversation covers Aydin's early exposure to entrepreneurship and international business, experience as the first international product manager at Google.

key_points.text: Aydin Senkut is the Founder and Managing Partner of Felicis Ventures.
Our conversation covers Aydin's early exposure to entrepreneurship and international business, experience as the first international product manager at Google.
We discuss his investment philosophy, proactive sourcing, and doing whatever it takes to join the cap table and support founders.
